🎬 LA to Vegas (2018)

LA to Vegas follows the hilarious and unpredictable adventures of a quirky airline crew working aboard Jackpot Airlines, a budget airline operating regular weekend flights between Los Angeles and Las Vegas. At the center of the story is Ronnie, a hardworking flight attendant who dreams of building a better future while dealing with demanding passengers, ridiculous situations, and the chaotic personalities of her coworkers. Alongside her is Captain Dave, an arrogant but entertaining pilot whose enormous ego and questionable decisions frequently create unexpected problems during their flights. Together with fellow flight attendant Bernard and an eccentric group of regular passengers, the crew experiences everything from awkward romantic encounters and outrageous gambling adventures to embarrassing misunderstandings and unexpected personal challenges. As Ronnie struggles to advance her career and navigate her complicated love life, she discovers that working in the airline industry is far more unpredictable than she ever imagined. From wild Las Vegas weekends and unusual passenger requests to workplace rivalries, romantic complications, and hilarious in-flight disasters, every journey brings a new adventure. Combining fast-paced comedy, memorable characters, workplace humor, and ridiculous situations, the series explores friendship, ambition, relationships, and the unpredictable chaos of life in the skies.

🎭 Genre: Sitcom • Comedy • Workplace Comedy

⭐ IMDb: 7.1/10

⏱️ Runtime: 22 minutes per episode • TV-14

🎥 Creator: Lon Zimmet

📺 Where to Watch: Check Amazon Prime Video, Apple TV, and Fandango at Home for current streaming or digital purchase availability. Availability varies by region.
